idx_budget_order_amount.name: idx_budget_order_amount
columns: CASE WHEN CASE WHEN json_extract(row_json,'$.invalid_amount')=1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(json_extract(row_json,'$.budget_amount'),json_extract(row_json,'$.appropriation_amount')) END IS NULL THEN -1 WHEN substr(CASE WHEN json_extract(row_json,'$.invalid_amount')=1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(json_extract(row_json,'$.budget_amount'),json_extract(row_json,'$.appropriation_amount')) END,1,1)='-' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC

CASE WHEN substr(CASE WHEN json_extract(row_json,'$.invalid_amount')=1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(json_extract(row_json,'$.budget_amount'),json_extract(row_json,'$.appropriation_amount')) END,1,1)='-' THEN -length(substr(CASE WHEN json_extract(row_json,'$.invalid_amount')=1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(json_extract(row_json,'$.budget_amount'),json_extract(row_json,'$.appropriation_amount')) END,2)) ELSE length(CASE WHEN json_extract(row_json,'$.invalid_amount')=1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(json_extract(row_json,'$.budget_amount'),json_extract(row_json,'$.appropriation_amount')) END) END DESC

CASE WHEN substr(CASE WHEN json_extract(row_json,'$.invalid_amount')=1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(json_extract(row_json,'$.budget_amount'),json_extract(row_json,'$.appropriation_amount')) END,1,1)<>'-' THEN CASE WHEN json_extract(row_json,'$.invalid_amount')=1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(json_extract(row_json,'$.budget_amount'),json_extract(row_json,'$.appropriation_amount')) END END DESC

CASE WHEN substr(CASE WHEN json_extract(row_json,'$.invalid_amount')=1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(json_extract(row_json,'$.budget_amount'),json_extract(row_json,'$.appropriation_amount')) END,1,1)='-' THEN substr(CASE WHEN json_extract(row_json,'$.invalid_amount')=1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(json_extract(row_json,'$.budget_amount'),json_extract(row_json,'$.appropriation_amount')) END,2) END ASC

idx_budget_order_remaining.name: idx_budget_order_remaining
columns: CASE WHEN json_extract(row_json,'$.remaining_amount') IS NULL THEN -1 WHEN substr(json_extract(row_json,'$.remaining_amount'),1,1)='-' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC

CASE WHEN substr(json_extract(row_json,'$.remaining_amount'),1,1)='-' THEN -length(substr(json_extract(row_json,'$.remaining_amount'),2)) ELSE length(json_extract(row_json,'$.remaining_amount')) END DESC

g2b_recovery_bounds.name: g2b_recovery_bounds
g2b_recovery_bounds.value: "g2b_recovery_generations"."pass" BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND "g2b_recovery_generations"."page" BETWEEN 1 AND 21 AND "g2b_recovery_generations"."attempts" BETWEEN 0 AND 42 AND "g2b_recovery_generations"."source_rows" BETWEEN 0 AND 20000 AND "g2b_recovery_generations"."payload_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 67108864 AND "g2b_recovery_generations"."target_rows"+"g2b_recovery_generations"."excluded_rows"="g2b_recovery_generations"."source_rows"

g2b_recovery_page_counts.name: g2b_recovery_page_counts
g2b_recovery_page_counts.value: "g2b_recovery_pages"."total" BETWEEN 0 AND 20000 AND "g2b_recovery_pages"."source_rows" BETWEEN 0 AND 999 AND "g2b_recovery_pages"."target_rows"+"g2b_recovery_pages"."excluded_rows"="g2b_recovery_pages"."source_rows"
